nodes.label: main.rs
nodes.desc: Tokio async runtime entry. Runs FIPS POST, WAL checkpoint timer, watchdog, and SocketListener.

nodes.label: DaemonState
nodes.desc: Central shared state: VMK (mlock'd), SQLite conn, SessionStore, challenge map, lockout tracker.

nodes.label: protocol.rs
nodes.desc: Defines all Request/Response enums. 40+ commands. msgpack wire format with deny_unknown_fields.

nodes.label: socket.rs
nodes.desc: SocketListener accepts Unix domain socket connections. Dispatches Request variants to vault state.

nodes.label: kdf.rs
nodes.desc: derive_kek_argon2 (256MiB/t3/p4) and derive_kek_pbkdf2 (1M iters). Both return 64-byte mlock'd LockedKey.

nodes.label: aes_gcm.rs
nodes.desc: AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt. Used for VMK wrapping and credential DEKs.

nodes.label: xchacha20.rs
nodes.desc: XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypt/decrypt. 24-byte nonce variant for passkey VMK wrapping.

nodes.label: secure_store.rs
nodes.desc: LockedKey: mlock()'d buffer zeroized on drop via Zeroize trait.

nodes.label: hibp.rs
nodes.desc: HIBP Cuckoo filter offline breach check. SHA-1 hash, never logs plaintext.

nodes.label: sign.rs
nodes.desc: Ed25519 / ECDSA signature utilities for FIDO2 assertion verification.

nodes.label: self_test.rs
nodes.desc: FIPS 140-3 power-on self tests (POST). Must pass at startup or daemon exits.

nodes.label: kdf_tune.rs
nodes.desc: Adaptive Argon2id parameter tuning targeting ~1s derivation on current hardware.

nodes.label: db.rs
nodes.desc: open_vault (SQLCipher key, migrations v0-v4), rekey_vault. WAL mode, FULL synchronous, foreign keys ON.

nodes.label: folders.rs
nodes.desc: CRUD for encrypted folder rows. Blind-indexed name search.

nodes.label: credentials.rs
nodes.desc: Encrypt/decrypt credential blobs with per-row DEK wrapped by VMK.

nodes.label: audit.rs
nodes.desc: Append-only audit log with BLAKE3 integrity chain. verify_chain() on every unlock.

nodes.label: session.rs
nodes.desc: SessionStore: in-memory HashMap, 15min idle TTL, 24h absolute TTL, 8 sessions/user, 1000 global cap.

nodes.label: fido2.rs
nodes.desc: FIDO2/WebAuthn assertion verification, VMK wrap key derivation, sign-counter clone detection.

nodes.label: totp.rs
nodes.desc: TOTP setup, confirmation, backup codes (Argon2id hashed), 6-digit HMAC-SHA1.

nodes.label: lockout.rs
nodes.desc: LockoutTracker: per-UID failed attempt counter, duress wipe threshold.

nodes.label: wipe.rs
nodes.desc: forensic_wipe: 7-pass DoD overwrite of vault.db and sidecar, then process exit.

nodes.label: user_profile.rs
nodes.desc: Encrypted user profile storage: name, email, profile picture (EXIF-stripped).

nodes.label: VaultHeader
nodes.desc: JSON sidecar file (vault.db.meta). Contains Argon2id salt/params, encrypted VMK, passkey sidecar entries, HMAC.

nodes.label: main.tsx
nodes.desc: React 19 root. Mounts ThemeProvider, NotificationProvider, VaultProvider, ErrorBoundary, RouterProvider.

nodes.label: router.tsx
nodes.desc: React Router v7 config. Auth guard via keyStore.hasToken. Lazy-loads all pages.

nodes.label: keystore.ts
nodes.desc: SecureKeyStore: JS private field for session token. PBKDF2-SHA-512 (v1) + Argon2id (v2) local key derivation.

nodes.label: daemonClient.ts
nodes.desc: DaemonClient: WebSocket msgpack proxy to daemon. FIFO request queue, timeout teardown, UUID wire helpers.

nodes.label: Login.tsx
nodes.desc: Login page: password, passkey, TOTP, YubiKey, quick unlock, recovery key flows. Phase A/B/C key derivation.

nodes.label: Vault.tsx
nodes.desc: Main credential list. Folder filtering, search, add/edit/delete credentials, TOTP codes, sharing.

nodes.label: Settings.tsx
nodes.desc: Settings: password change, MFA setup (TOTP/FIDO2/PQC), profile edit, KDBX import/export.

nodes.label: Dashboard.tsx
nodes.desc: Overview dashboard: vault health metrics, recent activity, credential stats.

nodes.label: BreachMonitor.tsx
nodes.desc: HIBP breach check UI. Checks all vault passwords against offline Cuckoo filter.

nodes.label: ManageFolders.tsx
nodes.desc: Drag-and-drop folder reordering (Framer Motion Reorder), create/edit/delete folders with custom SVG icons.

nodes.label: Setup.tsx
nodes.desc: First-run wizard. Creates vault, registers user profile, optionally enrolls FIDO2/TOTP.

nodes.label: Register.tsx
nodes.desc: Account registration page. Calls daemon.register() which calls unlock() then updateProfile().

nodes.label: AssetHolder.tsx
nodes.desc: Encrypted asset holder: emails, phone numbers, U2F key names.

nodes.label: VaultHealth.tsx
nodes.desc: Vault health page: audit log viewer, BLAKE3 chain verification, session info.

nodes.label: p2wFormat.ts
nodes.desc: P2W encrypted file format: AES-256-GCM encrypted export with HMAC-SHA-384 integrity. Padded to disguise size.

nodes.label: importExport.ts
nodes.desc: KDBX import/export, CSV, 1Password, Bitwarden format support. All parsing runs client-side.

nodes.label: mfa.ts
nodes.desc: WebAuthn navigator.credentials API wrapper for FIDO2 register/assert flows. PQC authenticator support.

nodes.label: securityModes.ts
nodes.desc: Security level definitions (L1-L5). Determines KDF params, session policy, MFA requirements.

nodes.label: localCrypto.ts
nodes.desc: Browser-side AES-GCM-256 encrypt/decrypt for local credential cache. Uses WebCrypto API.

nodes.label: quickUnlock.ts
nodes.desc: WebAuthn PRF extension for biometric quick unlock. DBK derived from PRF output.

nodes.label: sessionTracker.ts
nodes.desc: Client-side session idle timer. Auto-locks after inactivity by calling daemon.lock().

nodes.label: sanitize.ts
nodes.desc: DOMPurify wrapper for SVG sanitization. Used before rendering customSvg folder icons.

nodes.label: ShareModal.tsx
nodes.desc: Share credential links with expiry, single-view option.

nodes.label: EmergencyAccessModal.tsx
nodes.desc: Emergency access request/grant flow for trusted contacts.

nodes.label: Header.tsx
nodes.desc: App header with user avatar, notifications dropdown, theme toggle, logout.

nodes.label: Sidebar.tsx
nodes.desc: Navigation sidebar with vault, security, folders, settings links.

nodes.label: types.ts
nodes.desc: Shared TypeScript interfaces: Folder, Credential, AssetHolder, Notification, AuditEvent, ShareLink.

nodes.label: Contexts
nodes.desc: VaultContext, UserContext, ThemeContext, NotificationContext - React 19 contexts in main.tsx.

nodes.label: argon2.ts / kdf.worker
nodes.desc: Argon2id WASM binding. Runs in dedicated Web Worker to avoid blocking main thread during KDF.

nodes.label: monitor/main.rs
nodes.desc: PWDnowMonitoringENV: Tokio watchdog polling daemon socket, web health, disk, RAM, CPU every 10s.

nodes.label: risk.rs
nodes.desc: RiskEngine: evaluates collected metrics against thresholds, produces typed RiskEvent list.

nodes.label: action.rs
nodes.desc: ActionEngine: auto-healing (restart daemon/web), notifications (email/webhook), cooldown dedup.

nodes.label: config.rs
nodes.desc: TOML config. Hot-reloadable on SIGHUP (thresholds, healing, notify). Cold: log path, poll interval.

nodes.label: leak.rs
nodes.desc: LeakDetector: sliding-window monotonic RAM growth detector (36-sample window).

nodes.label: server.js
nodes.desc: Express server: serves SPA, injects CSP nonces, proxies /ws WebSocket to Unix socket daemon.

nodes.label: Makefile/deploy
nodes.desc: make build/build-pq/test/lint. Orchestrates cargo build --release and npm run build.

daemon.label: Vault Daemon (Rust)
daemon.description: Rust tokio async daemon handling all crypto, SQLite/SQLCipher storage, IPC

web.label: Web Frontend (React/TS)
web.description: React 19 SPA with TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4

meta.description: AST-based knowledge graph of the PWDnow two-layer password manager codebase
